title: How this draft was checked
body: drafter wrote the page from your approved blueprint before its budget ran out. A fresh fact-checker read 94 claims: 88 held and 6 were imprecise. The register editor's 25 findings, 6 blocking, were applied, and a recheck's 4 imprecise lines were fixed.

The blueprint was brought in line with the reviewed page after you approved it, so a later redraft keeps every fix. Each change rests on the code or a fact, and none changes the page's sections or the reader's path.

title: Audit every successful write
body: The draft never told the reader to call `ctx.audit`, so a screen built from it would write no audit record. The page now has that step. An action with no `access` option still audits its own write but logs no refusal, and the page says so.

title: Nested routes match Restrict admin access
body: A dynamic segment under a key that has a deeper sibling resolves to no rule. This page and Restrict admin access first chose different fixes. Both now give the same one: pass the governing key.
